name: block_image
title: Block Image
summary: Single image block that opens in the popup, optionally with a looping video over it.
description: Single image block: from the post media folder (image_path + image_file_name) or any image (img). Outlined card or plain, opens in the popup; optional cover, width and per-screen heights. With video (path under src/content/vid/, e.g. backgrounds/clip.webm) a muted video plays over the image through video_background (loops unless video_loop is false, pauses off screen, respects reduced motion); the image stays as poster, fallback and popup image.
